CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 26
   D. 5

2. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 37
   D. 31.7

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x

4. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 9
   D. 82

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 10
   C. 12
   D. 2

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 19
   C. 38
   D. 88

7. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

8. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 13
   C. 40
   D. 3

9. Solve for x: x + 5 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 15
   D. 11

10. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 33

11. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 2/2

12. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 25
   C. 19.6
   D. 19.7

13. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

14. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 48
   D. 144

15. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x = 5
   D. x < 5

16. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 6
   C. 7
   D. 36

17. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 169

18. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

19. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 90

20. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 42

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 120
   B. 30
   C. 46
   D. 23

22. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.7
   C. 15.6
   D. 21

23. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 1
   C. 57
   D. 15

24. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

26. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
